hints.title: Custom Precedence Frequency Tally
hints.text: Count the occurrences of every character in s. Emit characters in the exact order specified by the order string.

hints.title: Prescribed Order Emission
hints.text: Iterate through characters in order. For each character ch, append count[ch] copies to the output, then delete or zero out its count.

hints.title: Remaining Character Append
hints.text: After processing order, append all remaining characters from s that did not appear in order.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(Order + S) time and O(S) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full comparison-based sorting takes O(S log S) time, slower than linear bucket counting.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting frequencies of 26 English letters runs in linear time with O(1) extra space beyond output.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle characters appearing in s that are absent from the custom order.
